# Documentation

mini-trellis keeps project knowledge in Markdown and searches it alongside local coding-agent conversations. These guides describe **v0.3.8**.

## Start here

| Your starting point | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| A new or existing codebase | [Install and save your first decision](/install/) |
| An existing Trellis project | [Migrate from Trellis](/migration/) |
| Useful conversations to organize | [Turn selected history into project knowledge](/history/) |
| A working installation | [Use it during development](/using/) |
